acceptance_predicates.description: All ASB-owned user-visible output—including results, diagnostics, warnings, status, and updates—uses the typed configurable output router; direct output writes are mechanically rejected.
Project init writes output level normal and default ordinary-result stdout/operational stderr routing, while repeat init preserves an explicit user choice.
quiet, normal, verbose, and debug have enforced consistent filters and documented configuration/CLI precedence; -q selects quiet.
Configured writers have safe validated destinations and specific actionable failure diagnostics without exposing secrets or private host information.
--json ignores human writer routing, preserves the existing stdout envelope, and emits no human/result/diagnostic/status/progress bytes on either stream.

definition_of_done: Output router, project configuration, and all pre-existing ASB output routes are independently reviewed and covered by executable tests.
Default, repeat-init preservation, all levels, CLI overrides, destination failures, quiet, and JSON-silence tests pass.
Exact-head review, signed merge, and exact-main hosted evidence pass.

inputs.description: AR-1771 status, writer, level, quiet, stream, privacy, and JSON-silence contract.
AR-1766/1768 typed actionable diagnostics for output configuration and writer failures.

outputs.description: Mandatory typed configurable router for all ASB-owned output.
Generated and validated persistent project output configuration with normal default.

gates.description: Mechanical checks prove no ASB-owned user-visible writer bypasses the router.
Project-init/default/preservation, destination, level, override, quiet, and redaction matrix passes.
Every JSON route remains strictly silent on human streams and preserves exact schemas and exits.
